newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sons of Gwalia lifts gold hedges.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sons of Gwalia lifts gold hedges.

text.p: Gold miner Sons of Gwalia Ltd said on Tuesday it had aggegated its forward selling position with those of its subsidiaries Orion Resources NL and Gasgoyne Gold Mines NL and has entered into additional hedging transactions.

The current hedging book comprises two million ounces sold forward and 1.2 million ounces in put options, Sons of Gwalia said. As a result, Sons of Gwalia said it anticipates future gold sales prices of between A$630.00 and A$650.00 an ounce for deliveries in 1997/98 and 1998/99 financial years (July/June).
Gold currently fetches around A$458.00 an ounce.
